packageRules.description: Automerge low-risk updates (patch bumps and pin updates)
Keep Semgrep dependency updates human-reviewed.
Automerge minor GitHub Actions updates (SHA-pinned, low-risk)
Auto-merge submodule bumps (low-risk digest updates)
Ignore fullsend self-references (own reusable workflows and actions)

Group OpenShell base image and version pin into one PR. After a version bump, fetch and update OPENSHELL_SHA from the matching release tag (the github-releases datasource can't resolve a digest here because extractVersionTemplate strips the 'v' prefix that GitHub's tag lookup needs). Hold updates for 2 days so a release pulled upstream soon after publishing never becomes a PR (#4076, #3967). minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour=timestamp-optional is required: Renovate age-checks digest updates too, but ghcr gives it no release dates for the digest-pinned base image, so under the default timestamp-required every base-image update would be held forever. The version pin has a GitHub release date and is still held for 2 days.
Group Cloudflare Worker packages to prevent broken lockfile-only PRs from peer dependency conflicts

Red Hat rebuilds the UBI 10 base images (images/runner/Containerfile) almost daily. Group their digest bumps into one PR and only open it on Mondays (UTC) to cut the daily churn of protected-path PRs (#8187). Tag/version bumps are not affected.
After cosign version bump, verify the new binary's sigstore signature and update COSIGN_SHA256
After tirith version bump, fetch and update SHA256 checksums from the release
After a Go toolchain bump in the code and runner images, fetch and update GO_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in both Containerfiles from https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all (#8617)

pi releases ~weekly minors and has changed its --mode json wire shape within a minor before (0.84.0); require manual review so the stream parser fixtures (#6464) are re-verified before a pin bump lands, even for patch/pin updates

Vendored pi-anthropic-vertex extension (fullsend-ai/pi-anthropic-vertex, #7019): tag pin. After a bump, refresh PI_ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_SHA256 from the tag tarball, checked against the SHA256 in the release notes (#9121).

Vendored pi-xai-vertex extension (fullsend-ai/pi-xai-vertex, #6571): tag pin, not automerged, like the other two pi extensions. After a bump, refresh PI_XAI_VERTEX_SHA256 from the tag tarball, checked against the SHA256 in the release notes (#9121).

Vendored pi-inference-gateway extension (fullsend-ai/pi-inference-gateway, #8262): tag pin. After a bump, refresh PI_INFERENCE_GATEWAY_SHA256 from the tag tarball, checked against the SHA256 in the release notes (#9121).
After a ripgrep bump, refresh RIPGREP_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the sandbox Containerfile, checked against the release's .tar.gz.sha256 assets (#9121)
After an fd bump, refresh FD_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the sandbox Containerfile. fd ships no checksum file, so the download is checked against the digest GitHub records for each release asset (#9121)

After a gcloud CLI bump, refresh GCLOUD_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the runner Containerfile. Google lists checksums only for the current release, on its HTML install page, so the hash is computed from the dl.google.com HTTPS download (#9121)
After a gh CLI bump, refresh GH_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the runner Containerfile, checked against gh_<version>_checksums.txt (#9121)
After a gitleaks bump, refresh GITLEAKS_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the sandbox and runner Containerfiles, checked against gitleaks_<version>_checksums.txt (#9121)
After a gitsign bump, refresh GITSIGN_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the code Containerfile, checked against the release's checksums.txt (#9121)
After a lychee bump, refresh LYCHEE_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the code Containerfile, checked against the release's .tar.gz.sha256 assets (#9121)

OpenCode runtime (#8201): not automerged, for the same reason as pi and codex — a bump must re-verify the stream fixtures under internal/runtime/testdata/opencode. After a bump, refresh OPENCODE_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the sandbox Containerfile; opencode ships no checksum file, so the download is checked against the digest GitHub records for each release asset (#9121)

After an ONNX Runtime bump, refresh ORT_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in the runner Containerfile. ONNX Runtime ships no checksum file, so the download is checked against the digest GitHub records for each release asset (#9121)

codex minor bumps change the `codex exec --json` wire shape and the hook payloads, so the stream fixtures under internal/runtime/testdata/codex and the hook adapter must be re-verified before a pin move lands, even for patch/pin updates — the same reason pi is not automerged (#6920)

ty 0.0.x releases rename and split rules (0.0.98 renamed unresolved-import, #9133; 0.0.100 renamed unresolved-attribute and added missing-union-attribute, #9226), so a pin bump must re-check the ty hook's --ignore list in .pre-commit-config.yaml and the Makefile check target before it lands, even for patch/pin updates.
Keep the npx lint-staged pin in .pre-commit-config.yaml equal to the package-lock.json version, so one PR moves both (#9226). npx uses the local install only on an exact version match.
Keep the ruff-pre-commit rev and the Makefile uvx ruff pin on one version in one PR (#9226).
Pre-commit hooks are linters and scanners: a patch release can add or rename checks, and the code runs on contributor machines. Review hook rev bumps by hand (#9226).

customManagers.description: Track the OpenShell version pin in openshell-version.sh. OPENSHELL_SHA is updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-openshell-sha.sh) since the github-releases datasource can't resolve a digest for the version-only (no 'v' prefix) value produced by extractVersionTemplate.
Track the OpenShell version copies in the local agents guide (install snippet and supervisor image example) so they bump in the same openshell group PR as openshell-version.sh (#4808).

Track the OpenShell tag in the gateway configuration link of the harness reference (migrating proxy and certificate settings), so the link follows the pin in the same openshell group PR instead of pointing at a tag the pinned gateway does not match (#3373).
Track the gcloud CLI version pin in the runner image. GCLOUD_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-gcloud-checksums.sh).

Track the Go toolchain version pin baked into the code and runner sandbox images (images/code/Containerfile and images/runner/Containerfile, which must stay in sync per their own comments). GO_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in both files are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-go-checksums.sh).
Track wranglerVersion pins in site-deploy.yml so they bump with the cloudflare-workers group
Track Claude Code version pin in sandbox Containerfile

Track the pi-anthropic-vertex extension tag pinned in the sandbox image (fullsend-ai/pi-anthropic-vertex, #7019). PI_ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_SHA256 is updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-pi-anthropic-vertex-checksum.sh). The extension's own CI matrix (pinned PI_VERSION + latest pi) is the compatibility check.

Track the pi-xai-vertex extension tag pinned in the sandbox image (#6571). PI_XAI_VERTEX_SHA256 is updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-pi-xai-vertex-checksum.sh). Like pi-anthropic-vertex this extension mirrors no pi internals, so there is no sync/compat.json to re-check; confirm its peerDependencies floor still covers PI_VERSION instead (declared only — it installs with --omit=peer, so nothing enforces the floor at build time).

Track the pi-inference-gateway extension tag pinned in the sandbox image (fullsend-ai/pi-inference-gateway, #8262). PI_INFERENCE_GATEWAY_SHA256 is updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-pi-inference-gateway-checksum.sh). Like the Vertex extensions it mirrors no pi internals; the extension's own CI matrix (pinned PI_VERSION + latest pi) is the compatibility check.
Track the ripgrep pin in the sandbox image (pi's grep backend). RIPGREP_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-ripgrep-checksums.sh).
Track the fd pin in the sandbox image (pi's find backend). FD_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-fd-checksums.sh).
Track pi CLI version pin in the sandbox image (#6464). Bumps must re-verify the pi stream parser fixtures — the --mode json wire shape changed within a minor before (0.84.0).

Track the Codex CLI version pin in the sandbox image (#6920). The OpenShell base image ships its own @openai/codex under the same npm prefix, so the pinned install replaces it and the build asserts `codex --version`; a bump must re-verify the codex stream parser fixtures once they land (#6920).
Track tirith CLI version pin in the sandbox image. SHA256 checksums are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-tirith-checksums.sh).
Track cosign version pin in update-tirith-checksums.sh. COSIGN_SHA256 is updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-cosign-checksum.sh).

Track version-pinned uvx (PyPI) tool fetches in pre-commit hook entries and Makefile targets, e.g. `uvx ty@0.0.99`, `uvx ruff@0.15.7` (#9226). Unpinned fetches pick up each new release the moment it ships.
Track version-pinned npx (npm) tool fetches in pre-commit hook entries and Makefile targets, e.g. `npx lint-staged@16.4.0`; scoped package names are allowed (#9226).
Track the OpenCode runtime pin in the sandbox image (#8201). OPENCODE_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-opencode-checksums.sh).

Track the gitleaks pin in the sandbox and runner images, which must stay on the same version. GITLEAKS_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} in both files are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-gitleaks-checksums.sh).
Track the gh CLI pin in the runner image. GH_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-gh-checksums.sh).

Track the ONNX Runtime pin in the runner image (must stay >= the ORT C API version onnxruntime_go requests; see the Containerfile comment). ORT_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-ort-checksums.sh).

Track the lychee pin in the code image. Release tags are lychee-v<version> (the repo also tags lychee-lib-v<version>, which this ignores). LYCHEE_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-lychee-checksums.sh).
Track the gitsign pin in the code image. GITSIGN_SHA256_{AMD64,ARM64} are updated automatically by postUpgradeTasks (scripts/renovate/update-gitsign-checksums.sh).
